method.browser: Chromium; initial shared managed tab, then Main-owned dedicated headless CDP browser
method.navigation: Real query navigation followed by browser observation, rendered DOM inspection and saved full-page screenshots.
method.interaction: Native mouse clicks at rendered control bounds and native keyboard typing. The nine-round runs used rendered controls, not application function calls or injected game state.
method.textEnlargement: Doubled computed font sizes in the rendered page at 390x844 while retaining layout geometry; this is text-only stress, not a claim about an OS accessibility setting.
method.visualReview: All 150 default captures inspected through 21 inventory contact sheets; 38 core phone cases through six sheets, desktop through two sheets, enlarged text through three sheets, plus direct full-size representative images and named writing-state sheet.
method.captureNote: Stress captures scroll to document top before capture. A full-page Chromium capture initially included an unfocused fixed skip link outside the real viewport; measured negative viewport bounds confirmed the capture artifact, and clean captures were saved.

sound.hearingLimit: The browser verifier cannot hear physical audio output. Web Audio context and scheduling were observed using temporary read-through instrumentation, then restored.

fixes.change: Reduced the four-line oversized mobile hero to a compact two-line treatment; kept the original A little strange. Better together. character-led copy. Moved the writing constraint prompt to practical Nunito Sans.
Fixed nine overflowing long component headings and wrapping header/footer navigation. Added visible native-disclosure chevrons.

Removed the poem-corner character from recap/sharing columns where it overlapped practical copy. Full presentation rosters use stable responsive rows rather than allowing a long name to push one character above the group.
Prevented archive Read and presentation Exit labels from fragmenting. Wrapped room-code controls and constrained enlarged destination content within its card.
Constrained reader names and author attribution so 80-character names and 500-character lines remain readable at normal and doubled text size without horizontal overflow.
Replaced the broken __omp_shell expression with the actual toggle; fixed selected error-state retry.
Seeded reader from the entered name and reset favorite/public/set-public state at new-game start, preventing prior publication state from carrying into a new game.
Preserved edited drafts across offline restoration, component-boundary recovery and rerenders; captured the assigned round before activating a standalone writing specimen.
Replaced recovery buttons that only redisplayed the same error with actual local navigation/recovered states; update reload clears the notice without discarding draft.
Preserved logical focus through rerenders, kept the original modal trigger during nested/avatar updates, restored focus after close, and explicitly contained Tab/Shift+Tab.
Code Enter now advances focus rather than submitting entry. All three demo invitation controls route into the existing read-only invite state and focus pen name.
Sending no longer says Ready to send. Error fixtures retain a valid retryable four-word draft. Waiting error has an explicit accepted-receipt recovery state.
Separated reconnecting from sending: reconnecting remains editable, send stays blocked, and the surface shows one connection notice. Word-count updates retain the blocked policy.
Allowed overflow markers to wrap cleanly and stopped the +N label inheriting a tiny decorative stroke box.
Retained author-disclosure state during reader and favorite rerenders.
Updated controls inside an open appearance drawer after sound changes and made zero cue volume schedule no audible gain ramp.

visualJudgment.identity: Original joined-jelly mark, distinct composed silhouettes and a lavender/plum/mint/peach palette remain intact. The hero is a character-led answer, not Fold Club paper-language copy.
visualJudgment.restraint: Characters stay out of the phone writing plane and poem text; practical controls remain readable rectangular actions, not decorative blobs. Desktop recap characters no longer overlap actions.
visualJudgment.tone: No timers, writer ranking, distressed waiting faces, shaming copy or repeating waiting motion were observed. Soft silhouettes and DynaPuff can still read young; audience/age perception is a design risk, not a measured success claim.

limits: This is an offline single-writer design sketch with clearly marked synthetic people/account/public fixtures. No live room, real backend, multiplayer synchronization, authentication migration, real publication or deployment was exercised.

All inventory defaults and 132 named view states were navigated. Named-state rendering checks and representative visual inspection do not imply every possible interaction permutation of every component was exercised.
Physical sound could not be heard. Actual device volume, speakers/headphones, haptics and subjective audio comfort remain unverified.
The private SVG download was exercised and inspected. Real operating-system print/PDF UI and a native share sheet were not exercised; this Chromium reported native sharing unavailable.

Viewport emulation and native keyboard interaction are not real iOS/Android software-keyboard, safe-area, touch-device or screen-reader verification. Only Chromium was exercised, not Safari or Firefox.
Twofold text enlargement is a rendered-text stress technique, not a claim that every browser or OS zoom setting behaves identically.
Age/tone suitability and group/social comfort require real audience research; no audience approval is inferred from screenshots.

tooling.interruption: The shared JS VM was lost during an early sweep. Saved captures survived; navigation was recovered and all defaults completed. Main then provided a dedicated browser. Native mouse/keyboard events avoided unreliable high-level click helpers.
